summary: PBF Energy Inc. and its subsidiary PBF Holding Company LLC filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose a $500M offering of senior unsecured notes due 2034 and a conditional redemption of all $801.6M of its outstanding 6.00% Senior Notes due 2028. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is involved as this is a debt refinancing. The transaction is a standard capital markets operation: net proceeds from the new notes plus cash will redeem the 2028 notes. There is no special-situation M&A, activist, or restructuring element. Watch for pricing of the notes and closing details, but no risk-arb angle exists.
